title: Chrome Azural S (CAS) Plate Assay for Iron-Binding Compounds
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.idvca66

steps.title: Prepare CAS dye solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 60.5 mg of CAS dye (2 mM stock) in 50 mL Milli‑Q water, then bring the CAS solution to a final volume of 100 mL with additional Milli‑Q water.

steps.title: Add FeCl₃ to CAS solution
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL FeCl₃ solution (concentration undetermined) to the CAS solution.

steps.title: Prepare FeCl₃‑HCl/CAS mixture
steps.instruction: Mix 1.5 mL of FeCl₃‑HCl stock (1 mM FeCl₃ dissolved in 10 mM HCl) with 7.5 mL of the 2 mM CAS dye stock to obtain a Fe‑CAS mixture.

steps.title: Prepare CTAB stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 73 mg of CTAB (10 mM, HDTMA) in 40 mL Milli‑Q water.

steps.title: Dilute CTAB to working solution
steps.instruction: Take 6 mL of the 10 mM CTAB stock and mix with 40 mL Milli‑Q water to obtain a working CTAB solution.

steps.title: Make piperazine acid solution
steps.instruction: Slowly add 6.5 mL of 12 N HCl to 25 mL Milli‑Q water, then add 4.3 g anhydrous piperazine and mix to form the piperazine acid solution.

steps.title: Combine Fe‑CAS with CTAB
steps.instruction: While stirring, slowly add the Fe‑CAS mixture (from step 3) to the CTAB working solution (from step 5).

steps.title: Add piperazine acid to mixture
steps.instruction: Mix the piperazine acid solution (from step 6) slowly into the Fe‑CAS‑CTAB mixture.

steps.title: Adjust final volume
steps.instruction: Bring the combined solution up to a total volume of 1 L with Milli‑Q water.

steps.title: Add 5‑sulfosalicyclic acid
steps.instruction: Add enough 5‑sulfosalicyclic acid to achieve a final concentration of 4 mM in the solution.

steps.title: Prepare growth medium
steps.instruction: Prepare appropriate agar medium for the target microorganism (e.g., ESAW‑FE supplemented with casamino acids, peptone, and agar for marine microbes).

steps.title: Cool and pour plates
steps.instruction: Cool both part I (the reagent mixture) and part II (the agar medium) to 55 °C, then mix them together, pour into plates, and allow to solidify.

steps.title: Incubate and interpret halos
steps.instruction: Incubate plates under conditions suitable for the microorganism. After colonies grow, screen plates: yellow halos indicate siderophore production; blue zones indicate no siderophore.
